_comment: Where endpoint knowledge comes from. Every entry here was read by a person (or by a script in this repository) and its facts — labels and base URLs — were imported into seed.json. This is the provenance ledger for B2.2's sync worker: a source is added deliberately, with its licence and a pinned commit, never fetched at runtime from an unknown place.

sources.taken: provider labels, base URLs, the project's own exclusion list
sources.notTaken: no code — discovery adapters, credential scanners and scheduler are not used
no code — this is a Rust proxy with its own architecture

sources.taken: base URLs only; a URL is a fact, not creative expression
sources.notTaken: no code and no text, because no licence is declared
no code and no text, because no licence is declared

sources.licence: no licence declared — facts used, no text copied
sources.taken: base URLs and published free-tier terms for 12 providers: zai, watsonx, baseten, nebius, novita, ai21, alibaba-dashscope, vercel-ai-gateway, jina, arliai, clarifai, typhoon
sources.notTaken: its prose, its licence assessments, and its free_limits figures except the one stated exactly (watsonx 300,000 tokens/month)
sources.note: Every entry is needs_probe. A base URL from a third party is a candidate, not a route; only a probe makes it one.
